formal_target: mean E[G_t | information at settlement of the preceding publication hour]; current hour settles at its end+48 hours
caveat: Frozen forecasts, issuance eligibility and denominator are measurable at previous-hour settlement; final targets/availability settle by current-hour end+48h. Archive timestamps do not independently establish this historical availability. This is same-period settled-hour conditional-average gain, not issuance-conditioned or unknown-future-period forecasting risk.
